description: Defines the Args class for managing build arguments, including overrides, defaults, and scope setup, with related data structures and methods.

classes.name: Args
classes.description: Manages build arguments, including overrides, defaults, and scope setup, with tracking of used and unused variables.

classes.name: ValueWithOverride
classes.description: Represents a build argument value with optional override information.

methods.name: AddArgOverride
methods.description: Adds an override for a build argument specified on the command line.

methods.name: AddArgOverrides
methods.description: Adds multiple argument overrides from a scope.

methods.name: AddDefaultArgOverrides
methods.description: Adds default argument overrides from a scope.

methods.name: GetArgOverride
methods.description: Retrieves the override value for a specific argument.

methods.name: GetArgFromAllArguments
methods.description: Retrieves the override value for an argument from all arguments.

methods.name: SetupRootScope
methods.description: Sets up the root scope with system flags and toolchain overrides.

methods.name: DeclareArgs
methods.description: Declares arguments in a scope, marking them as used.

methods.name: VerifyAllOverridesUsed
methods.description: Checks if any overrides were specified but not used.

methods.name: GetAllArguments
methods.description: Returns all arguments, including defaults and overrides.

methods.name: set_build_args_dependency_files
methods.description: Sets the build files that may affect build arguments.
